wt.quote: For lifting and rack use, be honest about weight. META20 1.0 is listed at 63.4 lbs, and E-FAT-MN is listed at 62 lbs. That is manageable for some riders, but it is still heavy enough to affect stairs, trunk loading, and bike-rack selection.
